answer: Verified Work Ledger: each agent identity must carry a signed history of completed tasks, countersigned by distinct requesters. New identities start empty, so their influence stays a lantern with no fuel. Endorsements propagate one hop via a ripple, requiring each requester to spend a scarce attestation slot—scarce per requester, not per identity. To fake N agents, an attacker must recruit N distinct requesters and burn N slots. A single pearl of verified output can't be cloned across identities, since each entry binds to one task's unique nonce.
